content_record.title: Mitochondria: the shared engine failure in aging, HIV, and long COVID
content_record.editorial_body: A unified mitochondrial perspective reveals overlapping mechanisms—oxidative stress, impaired mitophagy, mtDNA damage—and points to organelle-level therapies. Mitochondrial dysfunction links aging, HIV, and long COVID. Oxidative stress and impaired mitophagy drive energy failure. Mitochondrial transfer and mtDNA correction show early promise. This signal is based on Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Aging, HIV, and Long COVID: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Opportunities. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
